version.description: Required manifest version, written as the plain integer 1. Core rejects decimal spelling such as 1.0 even when a JSON Schema validator treats it as an integer.

defaultAgents.description: Default recipients for components that omit agents. Omission defaults to codex and claude-code; an empty list selects no recipients. Component overrides and conditions further determine effective targets.

sources.description: Source aliases local to this declaration, retained in declaration order. References use these keys; aliases must be nonempty, must not be . or contain a colon, and must identify distinct normalized sources. Omission or an empty mapping declares none.

packages.description: Marketplace roots keyed by consumer alias. Each root specifies a catalog, package and version requirement. Member selections record the recipients requested by that root.

components.description: Direct component declarations, retained in order and checked even when their conditions select no targets. Omission or an empty sequence declares none.

groups.description: Named reusable groups, retained in declaration order. Defining a group does not activate it; uses selects it and exports makes it available to importers. Unused groups are still validated.

uses.description: Group references expanded in declaration order. Omission or an empty sequence activates no groups. Local reference cycles are errors, including in inactive groups.

exports.description: Names of local groups available to importing declarations, retained in order. Every name must name a declared group and occur once. Omission or an empty sequence exports none.

lifecycle.description: Ordered package-manager lifecycle actions. Project execution requires explicit local trust.

watch.description: Source aliases subscribed independently of installations. Names must be unique and refer to declared source aliases. Omission and an empty sequence are equivalent; watch order has set-like semantics.

title: Agents declaration
description: Version 1 declaration of symbolic sources, components and groups. Parsing validates supplied YAML without resolving sources, reading referenced resources or running programs. Unknown fixed fields and null optional fields are errors; omitted collections are empty unless a field says otherwise. Core diagnostics also enforce YAML scalar kinds, numeric identity and domain relationships that general JSON Schema cannot express.

kind.description: A local catalog directory, Git catalog or hosted HTTPS index.

location.description: A project-relative or absolute path for a directory, a Git repository locator, or a hosted HTTPS index URL.

ref.description: Git commit, branch or tag for release discovery. Omission uses the default branch.

subpath.description: Relative directory inside the Git catalog tree.

agent.description: Recipient identifier. Support for deploying an individual component is checked by its consuming operation; accepting the identifier does not imply every component is supported by that client.

agents.description: Only these recipients remain eligible. Omission leaves recipients unrestricted; an empty list matches none. Duplicate recipients are errors.

scopes.description: Only these installation scopes match. Omission allows either scope; an empty list matches neither. Duplicate scopes are errors.

platforms.description: Only these operating systems match. Omission allows either platform; an empty list matches neither. Duplicate platforms are errors.

condition.description: Intersecting restrictions on recipients, scope and platform. Omitted dimensions impose no restriction; an explicit empty dimension matches nothing. Nested group, use, component and section conditions combine by intersection, without removing inactive intent from the declaration.

path.description: Required relative resource path within the selected source. Absolute paths, home expansion and parent traversal are not allowed.

source.description: Alias declared in this document. Omission or . uses the current declaring source; imported declarations retain their own source context.

resource.description: A resource path with an optional source alias. It remains symbolic during declaration reads; linking resolves and confines it to the selected source root.

name.description: Instruction name relative to its instruction container, without .md. Nested names use / separators.

source.description: Source alias for this section. Omission or . selects the declaring source's own instructions; root user instructions require a named source when linking.

condition.description: Additional restrictions for this section, intersected with enclosing conditions. Omission imposes no additional restriction.

recipients.description: Exhaustive section recipients. Omission inherits the component's local recipients. An empty list selects none. ChatGPT App and Gemini App produce copyable text. Available on the component's sections. Named prompt sections inherit their prompt destination.

section.description: One instruction section reference. Section sequences retain their declared order and occurrences; the referenced content is read only by the consuming operation.

oneOf.description: Literal text, used exactly as supplied. Strings resembling binding syntax are not interpolated.

env.description: Name of an environment variable resolved locally by the consuming operation.

oneOf.description: Symbolic local environment binding; no value is captured in the declaration.

secret.description: Name of a secret resolved locally by the consuming operation's binding provider.

oneOf.description: Symbolic local secret binding; no value is captured in the declaration.

binding.description: A literal string or a symbolic local environment/secret binding. Declaration reads preserve the binding without looking up values. Only the consuming operation resolves bindings; they are not source-provided literals.

oneOf.description: Inline prompt body, including any literal newlines.

file.description: Resource containing the prompt body, resolved in its declaring source context.

oneOf.description: Prompt body read from a resource by the consuming operation.

prompt.description: Inline prompt text or a reference to a prompt file. Declaration reads do not read the file. Command input tokens use ${input:name}; $${input:name} escapes a literal token.

executable.description: Required program name or relative executable path. A bare name is resolved by the consuming operation; paths containing / are source resources. Reading the declaration never starts the program.

arguments.description: Arguments in invocation order, passed as individual strings. Omission or an empty sequence supplies no arguments.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory resource, resolved by the consuming operation. Omission leaves the directory unspecified in the declaration.
